samples.question: This picture shows one solid coloured blob shaped like a falling drop: a round body with exactly one drawn-out pointed tip, filled in a single colour with no holes. The tip points closer to one of the four edges of the picture -- top, bottom, left or right -- than to any corner. A short grey bar and a few small grey specks are drawn well away from the drop; they are decoration only, and where they lie tells you nothing about which way the drop's tip points. Which edge of the picture does the drop's tip point toward? Answer with exactly one of: top, bottom, left, right.
